Title: Observed own Danaan Loures court prefix receipts
EvidenceType: Sanitized server snapshots and decoded submitted actions; inventory restricted to Oren Brandy; research actor alias; no synthetic outcomes

Dialog.Name: Ase
Dialog.Text: Hello.

Actions.Selection: Any idea what they came to do here?

Dialog.Name: Ase
Dialog.Text: If you call a handful of soldiers from Loures taking a stroll along the beach unusual, then I have.

Choices.Text: Any idea what they came to do here?

Dialog.Name: Ase
Dialog.Text: I do not know for sure. They were looking for something, even brought an Acolyte to help them.

Dialog.Name: Ase
Dialog.Text: The waves bring a lot of strange things, I could not figure out what they wanted.

Choices.Text: Could they have been looking for a cap of some sort?

Dialog.Name: Ase
Dialog.Text: I am afraid not. If you are so interested, though, perhaps you could go for a walk in the capital. Someone there might be willing to share a secret or two, if you loosen them up enough...

Dialog.Name: Courtney
Dialog.Text: Hey there, Sparky! You look pretty tired, been running around too much lately?

Choices.Text: Yes, traveling a lot these last few days.

Dialog.Name: Courtney
Dialog.Text: I needed that once, too. So I went around asking people all sorts of questions I could think of, like why it never rains in Southern Abel and how many times must the surigams fly before they poke someone's eye.

Dialog.Name: Courtney
Dialog.Text: Finally, one rainy night, someone gave me the Ultimate Solution to all my questions.

Choices.Text: Would you just answer my questions, please?

Dialog.Name: Courtney
Dialog.Text: The Solution is very simple really, the answer is floating in the drink! Even jesters need a stiff one every now and then, you know!

Actions.Selection: Excuse me, I have to go.

Dialog.Name: Courtney
Dialog.Text: Something from Oren would be nice.

Choices.Text: Excuse me, I have to go.

Dialog.Name: Courtney
Dialog.Text: So soon? Well, be seeing ya!

Dialog.Text: Hello.  What can I do for you?

Dialog.Name: Franchesco
Dialog.Text: Hello Welcome to my Tavern, care for some refreshments?

Dialog.Name: Franchesco
Dialog.Text: Enjoy!

Choices.Text: Do you know anything about a special cap?

Actions.Selection: What do you know about it?

Dialog.Name: Courtney
Dialog.Text: Ah, so that was your interest all this time. Don't talk too loud, the King and Sir Thibault might hear you.

Choices.Text: What do you know about it?

Dialog.Name: Courtney
Dialog.Text: Not much. I overheard Jean telling the King about it. It has something to do with the deities, but not even the Apostles know much about it. I guess you'd have to ask one of the gods themselves - whichever is more prone to sharing knowledge. All in Loures are forbidden to talk about it.

Dialog.Name: Courtney
Dialog.Text: Ah, so that was your interest all this time. Don't talk too loud, the King and Sir Thibault might hear you.

Choices.Text: What do you know about it?

Dialog.Name: Courtney
Dialog.Text: It's believed so. It seems Jean found a way to locate its general position, some magical stuff he's been dealing with in the basements. One night he screamed "I found it!" and the next morning a bunch of soldiers went off on a "special mission" to Abel, then we got the weird orders. Suspicious, isn't it? Well, since then I saw no more special missions, so I assume it's still here in the castle.

Dialog.Name: Logan
Dialog.Text: Hello.  What can I do for you?

Actions.Selection: I am eager to continue, I wish to help the boy.

Dialog.Name: Logan
Dialog.Text: You have come far in your search, have you not? But more awaits ahead of you.

Choices.Text: I am eager to continue, I wish to help the boy.
More!? But I have been to all corners of Temuair already!

Dialog.Name: Logan
Dialog.Text: Yes, the boy in Abel. I am surprised you still remember he was the first step of this endless walk. Helping the boy is the largest of the tasks.

Dialog.Name: Logan
Dialog.Text: There are many others.

Choices.Text: What will I gain in the end?

Dialog.Name: Logan
Dialog.Text: You must first track your prize's origins. You are close. The tortuous path that you seek lies in damp marshes beyond these mountains. Look for information there, but remember, as Deoch has great goodness behind his dark figure, important information may be hidden behind what seems ignorant.

Dialog.Name: Logan
Dialog.Text: My role in your epic pursuit is done. Go now, may the Light of Danaan guide you.
